rows.name: DuckDuckGo Browser for Android
rows.reason: DuckDuckGo's Android browser documents privacy and Play installation. Reload placement, usability and historical version mapping remain unknown; repository retrieval failed, and snippets were not verified implementation evidence.

rows.name: Apple Safari iOS application
rows.reason: Apple’s iOS browser is for Apple devices, so it cannot meet the required Android installation through Google Play, regardless of its privacy features.

rows.name: Brave Browser
rows.reason: Brave provides a complete Android browser through Google Play with documented privacy protections. No decisive violation; retain with current reload placement and personal usability explicitly unverified.

rows.name: Brave Browser
rows.reason: Play-installable Android browser with tracker blocking; dated support evidence locates reload in the three-dot menu, though current-version placement still merits checking.

rows.name: Firefox Focus for Android
rows.reason: Firefox Focus for Android offers Play installation, tracking protection and session erasure. It remains Mozilla; reload location is unverified, and erased sessions may not suit persistent everyday browsing.

rows.name: Apple Safari iOS application
rows.reason: Apple documents Safari for macOS/iOS/iPadOS; this candidate is an iOS app. It cannot replace Android Firefox through Google Play; privacy features do not resolve the platform mismatch.

rows.name: Brave Search
rows.reason: A privacy-focused search service used inside browsers; it cannot replace Firefox’s Android application or provide its browser-level reload control.

rows.name: Vivaldi for Android
rows.reason: Vivaldi Android documents Play installation, address-bar reload, navigation and blocking controls. Current help requires Android 10+; interface/privacy settings need review, and exact current layout is undated.

rows.name: Brave Search
rows.reason: Brave Search operates inside an existing browser. Changing the search service preserves the browser and reload controls, so it does not provide the requested whole-browser replacement.

rows.name: Brave for Android
rows.reason: Play-installed Android browser documents privacy/customization. Reload placement and personal interface fit unverified; listing postdates question. This does not claim reload is unavailable.

rows.name: Brave for Android
rows.reason: Play-installed tracker/ad blocker; easy Android reload access unverified. Optional AI/Rewards/VPN may complicate UI; Play data-safety section reports possible collection. Confirm reload meets access requirement.

rows.name: DuckDuckGo for Android
rows.reason: Play-installed Android browser offers tracking protection/data clearing. Reload location/accessibility unverified; source-file access failed. Android protection limits documented; current store listing includes optional AI/subscription features.

rows.name: Vivaldi for Android
rows.reason: Android browser documents reload, persistent controls, blocking and Play installation. Requires Android 10+; user's version/usability unknown. Bottom bars may move controls into menus; October 21 build unverified.
